 Apple Black Friday Deals Available Now: AirPods, Apple Watches, MacBooks, and More
 Friday November 20, 2026 3:03 pm PST by Mitchel Broussard Black Friday is nearly here, taking place on Friday, November 27 in 2026. As always, this will be the best time of the year to shop for great deals, including popular Apple products like AirPods, iPad, Apple Watch, and more.
 Note: MacRumors is an affiliate partner with some of these vendors. When you click a link and make a purchase, we may receive a small payment, which helps us keep the site running. 
 Many of this year's best deals are already live, and in this article we're sharing all of the Apple products that currently have all-time low prices, or discounts that are at least close to their record-low prices. Of course, these are still early Black Friday deals, so even better discounts could emerge next week, but if you're shopping right now these are all the best prices around.
 Best Apple Black Friday Deals 2026 - AirPods, Apple Watch, MacBooks & More MacRumors Watch on YouTube 
 Table of Contents
 You can use the links below to jump directly to the section you're shopping for today.

 AirPods
 Notable AirPods deals this month include solid second-best prices on the AirPods Pro 3 and AirPods Max 2, with up to $130 off these models.
 $70 OFF 
AirPods Pro 3 for $179.00 
 $130 OFF 
AirPods Max 2 for $419.00 
 Beats 360
 Amazon has introduced a major discount on the brand new Beats 360 headphones for Black Friday, now available for $249.00 in the Black and Cloud color options, down from $349.00. You can get the Sky color on sale at this price over at Best Buy .
 $100 OFF 
Beats 360 for $249.00 
 Previous discounts on the Beats 360 only reached about $20 off, so this new Black Friday sale is the first time we're tracking a huge discount on the headphones.
 HomeView
 You can get the Starlight HomeView for $289.99 this Black Friday, down from $299.00. Although only a $9 discount, this is still biggest deal we've seen on the HomeView, and as of writing only Amazon is offering any sort of discount on the device.
 $9 OFF 
HomeView for $289.99 
 AirTag 2
 Apple's AirTag 2 has hit $23.00 this week on Amazon, down from $29.00. This deal is on the 1-Pack of the AirTag 2, and it's an all-time low price.
 $6 OFF 
AirTag 2 (1-Pack) for $23.00 
 Apple Watch
 Series 12
 You can get the 42mm GPS Apple Watch Series 12 for $329.00 at Amazon and the 46mm GPS model for $379.00 at Best Buy, both of which are $70 discounts and new all-time low prices. Amazon's selection of colors and styles is limited as of writing, while Best Buy has more options on sale .
 $70 OFF 
Apple Watch Series 12 (42mm GPS) for $329.00 
 $70 OFF 
Apple Watch Series 12 (46mm GPS) for $379.00 
 Amazon also has both Dark Bronze Milanese Loop models on sale for new record low prices today, starting at $379.00 for the 42mm GPS model and increasing to $429.00 for the 46mm GPS model.
 $70 OFF 
Apple Watch Series 12 (42mm GPS Milanese) for $379.00 
 $70 OFF 
Apple Watch Series 12 (46mm GPS Milanese) for $429.00 
 We've created a big list of more Apple Watch Series 12 models on sale below, including Titanium and Ceramic options at new best-ever prices. Remember that Best Buy is matching these deals as well if you prefer to shop there.
 42mm Cellular Black Aluminum with Black Sport Band - $429.00 ($70 off)
 42mm Cellular Dark Bronze Aluminum with Dark Bronze Milanese Loop - $479.00 ($70 off)
 46mm Cellular Black Aluminum with Black Sport Band - $479.00 ($70 off)
 46mm Cellular Dark Bronze Aluminum with Dark Bronze Milanese Loop - $529.00 ($70 off)

 42mm Natural Titanium with Navy Blue Sport Band - $629.00 ($70 off)

 46mm Night Blue Ceramic with Navy Blue Sport Band - $879.00 ($70 off)
 SE 3
 Amazon has all-time low prices across a number of Apple Watch SE 3 devices for Black Friday. Prices start at just $199.00 for the 40mm GPS Apple Watch SE 3, matching the previous record low price on this model and marking the first time we've tracked a discount on the SE 3 this Black Friday season.
 $50 OFF 
Apple Watch SE 3 (40mm GPS) for $199.00 
 $50 OFF 
Apple Watch SE 3 (44mm GPS) for $229.00 
 The 44mm GPS SE 3 is priced at $229.00 in this sale, down from $279.00, another record low price. Similar to the Series 12 sale, Best Buy is matching all of these prices .
 Anyone shopping for cellular models will find the 40mm GPS device priced at $249.00 and the 44mm GPS device priced at $279.00 , both $50 discounts and another pair of all-time low prices.
 $50 OFF 
Apple Watch SE 3 (40mm Cell) for $249.00 
 $50 OFF 
Apple Watch SE 3 (44mm Cell) for $279.00 
 Ultra 3
 Best Buy this week has a big collection of Apple Watch Ultra 3 models for $549.00 , down from $799.00. This is a massive $250 discount on the previous-generation device, and it represents a new all-time low price on these models.
 $250 OFF 
Apple Watch Ultra 3 for $549.00 
 Mac
 M6 MacBook Pro
 Starting with the cheaper model, Amazon now has the entry-level 14-inch M6 MacBook Pro (16GB RAM/1TB) for $1,849.00 , down from $1,999.00. You can get this computer, plus the models with upgraded 24GB and 32GB of RAM, on sale for $150 off for Black Friday.
 $150 OFF 
14-inch M6 MacBook Pro for $1,849.00 
 14-inch 16GB RAM/1TB - $1,849.00, down from $1,999.00
 14-inch 24GB RAM/1TB - $2,049.00, down from $2,199.00
 14-inch 32GB RAM/1TB - $2,249.00, down from $2,399.00
 MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR
 Moving to the 16-inch MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display, Amazon has up to $250 off these models for Black Friday. Prices start at $3,249.00 for the 24GB RAM/1TB MODEL, which is a $150 discount on the computer. We aren't currently tracking any deals on the 14-inch models, but we'll update this article if they appear.
 $150 OFF 
16-inch MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR for $3,249.00 
 16-inch 24GB RAM/1TB - $3,249.00, down from $3,399.00
 16-inch 48GB RAM/1TB - $3,799.00, down from $3,999.00
 16-inch 36GB RAM/2TB - $4,549.00, down from $4,799.00
 16-inch 48GB RAM/2TB - $5,149.00, down from $5,399.00
 M5 MacBook Air
 Amazon is taking $250 off nearly every model of the M5 MacBook Air this week, with matches of the best post-hike prices we've ever seen on the computer. Prices now start at $1,049.99 for the 512GB 13-inch model and $1,249.00 for the 512GB 15-inch model.
 $249 OFF 
13-inch M5 MacBook Air (16GB/512GB) for $1,049.99 
 $250 OFF 
13-inch MacBook Air (16GB/1TB) for $1,349.00 
 $250 OFF 
13-inch M5 MacBook Air (24GB/1TB) for $1,549.00 
 For the 15-inch M5 MacBook Air models, prices start with the 16GB/512GB model for $1,249.00 , down from $1,499.00. You can also get the 16GB/1TB model for $1,549.00 , down from $1,799.00, which is a $250 markdown and another all-time low price for Black Friday.
 $250 OFF 
15-inch M5 MacBook Air (16GB/512GB) for $1,249.00 
 $250 OFF 
15-inch M5 MacBook Air (16GB/1TB) for $1,549.00 
 MacBook Neo
 Amazon has a rare discount on the MacBook Neo for Black Friday, discounting all four of the entry-level 256GB models down to $649.00 , from $699.00. This sale is available in Silver, Indigo, Citrus, and Blush, with an estimated delivery date of November 22 for most models.
 $50 OFF 
MacBook Neo (256GB) for $649.00 
 $50 OFF 
MacBook Neo (512GB) for $749.00 
 This is a $50 discount on the MacBook Neo, and it's now the best price we've seen on the computer since Apple's price increases over the summer. There's a similar $50 discount on the 512GB MacBook Neo with Touch ID, available for $749.00 , down from $799.00, which is another rare discount and best-ever price.
 Mac mini
 Apple's new Mac mini has had one of the most consistent discounts over the past few weeks, and these $119-$150 markdowns have continued into Black Friday season. Prices start at $779.00 for the entry-level model, and currently include every M6 model, plus the M5 Pro model.
 $120 OFF 
M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB for $779.00 
 $150 OFF 
M6 Mac mini 16GB/512GB for $949.00 
 $149 OFF 
M6 Mac mini 24GB/512GB for $1,149.99 
 $150 OFF 
M5 Pro Mac mini 24GB/512GB for $1,549.00 
 Mac Studio
 Additionally, one of the best early Black Friday deals is on the M5 Max Mac Studio with 36GB RAM and a 512GB SSD, on sale for $2,299.00 , down from $2,499.00.
 $200 OFF 
M5 Max Mac Studio 36GB/512GB for $2,299.00 
 Studio Display
 Amazon this week introduced the first discounts on the Apple Studio Display in months, with $200 off every model of the 2026 display, plus a $300 discount on the Studio Display XDR as well.
 $200 OFF 
Apple Studio Display for $1,399.00 
 Prices start at $1,399.00 for the Standard Glass Studio Display with Tilt-Adjustable Stand, down from $1,599.00. Across the board, these are all some of the best discounts we've ever seen on the Studio Display.

 iPad
 M4 iPad Air
 Amazon this week has multiple early Black Friday discounts on the M4 iPad Air , providing $100 off nearly every model. These remain the best prices we've seen in the wake of Apple's summer price hikes, and many deals are being matched at Best Buy .

13-inch M4 iPad Air for $849.00 
 We haven't tracked this many deals on the M4 iPad Air since Prime Day in October, and this time around you'll find savings on both the 11-inch and 13-inch models. All of these discounts have been automatically applied and do not require a coupon code or a special membership.

 Amazon has a few of the previous-generation iPad mini 7 models on sale for $115 this Black Friday season, starting at $484.00 for the 128GB Wi-Fi model.
 $115 OFF 
iPad mini 7 (128GB Wi-Fi) for $484.00 
 $115 OFF 
iPad mini 7 (256GB Wi-Fi) for $584.00

 iPhone
 Cellular carriers have always offered big savings on the newest iPhone models during the holidays, and Black Friday 2026 sales have kicked off at AT&T and T-Mobile , as well as Best Buy . Right now we're tracking notable offers on the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and iPhone Duo. For even more savings, keep an eye on older models during the holiday shopping season.
 T-Mobile
 iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max : Up to $1,200 off with eligible trade-in
 iPhone Duo : Up to $1,200 off with eligible trade-in
 Apple Watch SE 3: No cost (up to $300) when adding a watch line on a qualifying plan, or get $250 off any Apple Watch when picking up another Apple Watch
 T-Mobile is offering the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max for up to $1,200 off when you trade in an old device (in any condition) and purchase the new device on an eligible unlimited plan. You can also get this offer if you switch a line to Experience Beyond 2.0, Experience Beyond, or Go5G Next.
 UP TO $1,200 OFF 
iPhone 18 Pro at T-Mobile 
 UP TO $1,200 OFF 
iPhone Duo at T-Mobile 
 For anyone shopping for the iPhone Duo, you can get up to $1,200 off the iPhone Duo with any condition trade-in on an Experience Beyond plan. This discount will appear in the form of bill credits over the course of 36 months.
 Similarly, if you're on the Experience More or Experience Beyond plan, you can get up to $830 off with a trade-in, and up to $730 off with a new line on most other plans. All of these offers have the same payout schedule over the course of 36 months.
 AT&T
 iPhone 18 Pro : No cost with eligible trade-in
 iPhone 18 Pro Max : Up to $1,200 off with eligible trade-in
 iPhone Duo : Up to $1,200 off with eligible trade-in
 Over at AT&T , you can get the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max for up to $1,200 off with an iPhone trade-in in any condition. You'll need to upgrade with AT&T Next Up Anytime or switch to get this offer.
 UP TO $1,200 OFF 
iPhone 18 Pro at AT&T 
 UP TO $1,200 OFF 
iPhone Duo at AT&T 
 Additionally, new and existing customers can get up to $1,200 off the iPhone Duo with an eligible trade-in. If you're switching to AT&T, the carrier will give you up to $800 to pay off your current device balance, and you can save $200 per line when ordering the smartphone online.
 In regards to the main offer of up to $1,200 off the iPhone Duo, AT&T says this requires an eligible trade-in of $230 or more, alongside activation of a new line or upgrading an existing line. You'll get this credit over the course of 36 months on your AT&T bill.
 You can find the breakdown of each plan tier from AT&T below, and remember that they each require a trade-in as well.
 Up to $1,200 off iPhone Duo: requires AT&T Premium 2.0 plan or higher / trade-in value of $230 or more
 Up to $930 off iPhone Duo: requires AT&T Extra 2.0 plan or higher / trade-in value of $130 or more
 Up to $500 off iPhone Duo: requires Value 2.0 plan / trade-in value of $130 or more
 Up to $350 off iPhone Duo: requires any eligible unlimited plan / trade-in value of $35-$129
 If you switch to AT&T from a different carrier, AT&T will pay off your phone balance at up to $800 off per line. With the $1,200 offer, AT&T is offering the 256GB iPhone 18 Pro at no cost.
 Best Buy
 iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max : Up to $1,200 off with qualified activation and trade-in
 iPhone Duo : Up to $1,200 off with qualified activation and trade-in
 Carriers aren't the only place you can save on iPhones this year, with Best Buy offering the same discounts as AT&T and T-Mobile with activation through these carriers at the time of purchase. This is a great option for anyone who shops at Best Buy a lot and likes to rack up member reward points.
 UP TO $1,200 OFF 
iPhone 18 Pro at Best Buy 
 UP TO $1,200 OFF 
iPhone Duo at Best Buy 
 Similar to the carriers, you can get the iPhone 18 Pro models and iPhone Duo for up to $1,200 off with qualified activation on cellular plans and a trade-in of an older device. Best Buy supports activation through AT&T and Verizon.
 iPhone Cases
 Amazon this week has big discounts across Apple's Clear, Silicone, and TechWoven Cases for the iPhone 18 Pro lineup. Across the board these are the best prices we've tracked to date on the new cases for iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. This time around the deals do not require any coupon codes to see the final sale prices.

iPhone 18 Pro Cases at Amazon

 iPhone 18 Pro Max

 iPhone Duo 
If you're on the hunt for protection for your new iPhone Duo, we've also been keeping track of all the best cases and screen protectors for the new device. The catch with these accessories is that many of them are not on sale given how new the Duo is, but there are overall cheap options you can find on Amazon, plus a great deal at ZAGG.
 UP TO 40% OFF 
iPhone Duo Accessories at ZAGG 
 Amazon has some notable TechWoven dupe cases on sale, available for $28.04 , which is $50 cheaper than any of Apple's official iPhone Duo cases. Otherwise, you'll find the full list of retailers offering accessories for the iPhone Duo below.
